GenAiPlugin.description: Handles MRI pre-authorization requests end-to-end: identity verification, benefits check, fraud scoring, case create/update.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Help members submit MRI pre-authorization requests: verify identity via Member ID, collect CPT + ordering provider NPI + clinical indication, call benefits eligibility and fraud scoring in parallel, create a Case, synthesize an approval or route to human review. Activate when the member mentions MRI, pre-auth, prior authorization, imaging approval, or a CPT code starting with 7.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Ask for Member ID first if not provided. Collect CPT code (or body part, then infer CPT), ordering provider NPI, and clinical indication. Create the Case immediately to obtain a caseId. In parallel, call Check Eligibility and Score Fraud Risk. Auto-approve ONLY when eligible AND in-network AND risk_score < 0.3 — call Update Pre-Auth Case Decision with decision="Working", generate an authorization number in the form AUTH-NNNN, and include the rationale. Otherwise route to human review: Update Pre-Auth Case Decision with decision="Escalated" and include fraud + benefits reasoning in the rationale. Respond to the member with the decision plus the auth number (if approved) or the expected reviewer SLA (if queued, citing state prompt-pay statutes for TX, CA, NY, or WA). Minimum-necessary PHI — never expose SSN, address, or email; confirm only Member ID and first name.
